note: Set B correctly identifies the 3-inch diameter openings for the roof beams (C1 and E6), whereas Set A incorrectly claims 8-inch or 6-inch rectangular openings for these members (e.g., claiming E6 has 8-inch openings). Set B also more accurately associates specific beam labels (B4, C4) with their sections, while Set A confuses Grid 2 (A4) and Grid 6 (A1) labels and dimensions. Both sets share some errors regarding the 6-inch opening width for Grid 6 (actual is 10-inch), but Set B's fidelity to the distinct roof beam details makes it superior.
